import math

string real_text(real64 value)
    formatted := "{value:.4}"
    return if formatted == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else formatted

int rounded_key(real64 value)
    rounded := math.round(value * 10000.0)
    return rounded

string proportion_text(int numerator, int denominator)
    return "{numerator}/{denominator} {real_text(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator))}"

string fraction_text(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "- -"
    first := numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return proportion_text(numerator / first, denominator / first)

class Evaluation(local int class_count, local int[] truths, local int[] predictions)
    int[][] matrix := array(nat(class_count), fill = array(nat(class_count), fill = 0))
    total := int(#truths)
    correct := 0
    real64 micro_f1 := 0.0
    real64 macro_f1 := 0.0
    for: row < total
        matrix[truths[row]][predictions[row]] += 1
    local real64 f1_sum := 0.0
    local scored := 0
    for: category < class_count
        correct += matrix[category][category]
        predicted := [for row := matrix[] then row[category]].sum()
        actual := matrix[category].sum()
        denominator := predicted + actual
        if denominator > 0
            f1_sum += real64(2 * matrix[category][category]) / real64(denominator)
            scored += 1
    micro_f1 = real64(correct) / real64(total)
    macro_f1 = f1_sum / real64(scored)

    int support(int category)
        return matrix[category].sum()

    int predicted_count(int category)
        return [for row := matrix[] then row[category]].sum()

    string[] lines(string[] names)
        output := ["true\predicted " + names.join(" ")]
        for: category < int(#names)
            cells := [for count := matrix[category][] then "{count}"]
            output = output.append(names[category] + " " + cells.join(" "))
        for: category < int(#names)
            hits := matrix[category][category]
            int predicted := predicted_count(category)
            int actual := support(category)
            output = output.append("class {names[category]} precision {fraction_text(hits, predicted)} recall {fraction_text(hits, actual)} f1 {fraction_text(2 * hits, predicted + actual)} support {actual}")
        return output.append("micro_f1 {real_text(micro_f1)} macro_f1 {real_text(macro_f1)}")

import collections
import math
import lexical = "./tokenizer.qui"
import vocab = "./vocabulary.qui"
import bayes = "./naive_bayes.qui"
import centers = "./rocchio.qui"
import metrics = "./evaluation.qui"

string[] model_names()
    return ["multinomial", "bernoulli", "complement", "rocchio", "vote"]

int[][] model_pairs()
    return [[0, 1], [0, 2], [0, 3], [1, 2], [1, 3], [2, 3]]

string[] read_lines(string path)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] rows := source_text.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<#rows - 1]

string[] parameter_values(string line)
    fields := line.split(" ")
    return fields[1:<#fields]

int hundredths(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    return 100 * int(parts[0]) + int(parts[1])

string hundredths_text(int value)
    remainder := value % 100
    padding := if remainder < 10 then "0" else ""
    return "{value / 100}.{padding}{remainder}"

int class_position(string[] names, string wanted)
    for: position < int(#names)
        if names[position] == wanted
            return position
    return -1

string class_counts_text(string[] names, int[] counts)
    return [for position := (0:<int(#names))[] then "{names[position]} {counts[position]}"].join(" ")

int bucket_number(int value, int[] limits)
    return [for boundary := limits[] if value >= boundary then 1].sum()

string[] evaluation_fields(metrics.Evaluation result)
    return ["{result.correct}", metrics.real_text(result.micro_f1), metrics.real_text(result.macro_f1)]

string[] join_blocks(string[][] parts)
    string[] lines := []
    for block := parts[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(block)
    return lines

void write_output(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

class Settings(local string[] rows)
    int[] alphas := [for value := parameter_values(rows[0])[] then hundredths(value)]
    minimum := int(parameter_values(rows[1])[0])
    features := int(parameter_values(rows[2])[0])
    bool include_bigrams := parameter_values(rows[3])[0] == "yes"
    top := int(parameter_values(rows[4])[0])
    int[] curve := [for value := parameter_values(rows[5])[] then int(value)]
    int[] sizes := [for value := parameter_values(rows[6])[] then int(value)]
    int[] thresholds := [for value := parameter_values(rows[7])[] then hundredths(value)]
    int[] lengths := [for value := parameter_values(rows[8])[] then int(value)]
    iterations := int(parameter_values(rows[9])[0])
    int weight := hundredths(parameter_values(rows[10])[0])
    resamples := int(parameter_values(rows[11])[0])
    seed := int(parameter_values(rows[11])[1])

class Document(string name, int label, lexical.Tokens parts)
class Input(Settings settings, string[] classes, Document[] training, Document[] tests, Document[] unlabelled)
    class_count := int(#classes)
    int[] labelled := [for position := (0:<int(#tests))[] if tests[position].label >= 0 then position]
    int[] truths := [for position := labelled[] then tests[position].label]

Input read_input()
    settings := Settings(read_lines("input/params.txt"))
    distinct<string> stops
    for word := read_lines("input/stopwords.txt")[]
        .stops.add(word)
    rows := [for line := read_lines("input/train.txt")[] then line.split(HT)]
    distinct<string> names
    for fields := rows[]
        .names.add(fields[0])
    classes := names.sorted()
    Document[] training := []
    for: position < int(#rows)
        training = training.append(Document("{position + 1}", class_position(classes, rows[position][0]), lexical.Tokens(rows[position][1], stops)))
    Document[] tests := []
    for line := read_lines("input/test.txt")[]
        fields := line.split(HT)
        tests = tests.append(Document(fields[0], class_position(classes, fields[1]), lexical.Tokens(fields[2], stops)))
    Document[] unlabelled := []
    for line := read_lines("input/unlabelled.txt")[]
        unlabelled = unlabelled.append(Document("{#unlabelled + 1}", -1, lexical.Tokens(line, stops)))
    return Input(settings, classes, training, tests, unlabelled)

class Training(local Document[] documents, bool include_bigrams, local int class_count, local int minimum, local int features, local int[] alphas := [])
    local sequences := [for document := documents[] then document.parts.terms(include_bigrams)]
    local labels := [for document := documents[] then document.label]
    wordset := vocab.Vocabulary(sequences, labels, class_count, minimum, features)
    local int[][] encoded := [for sequence := sequences[] then wordset.encode(sequence)]
    tallies := bayes.Counts(encoded, labels, class_count, wordset.vocabulary_size())
    centroid := centers.Centroids(encoded, labels, class_count, wordset.frequencies)
    bayes.Model[] fitted := []
    if #alphas > 0
        for: model < 3
            fitted = fitted.append(bayes.train(model_names()[model], tallies, alphas[model]))

    int[] encode(Document document)
        return wordset.encode(document.parts.terms(include_bigrams))

    bayes.Prediction classify(int model, int[] sequence)
        return if model == 3 then centroid.predict(sequence) else fitted[model].predict(sequence)

class Fold(int train_count, int validate_count, int candidates, int vocabulary_size)
class Run(int[] predictions, metrics.Evaluation evaluation, int[] fold_correct)
class CrossValidation(Run[][] candidates, Fold[] folds)
    selected := array(3, fill = 0)
    Run[] chosen := []
    for: model < 3
        best := 0
        for: 1 <= position < int(#candidates[model])
            if metrics.rounded_key(candidates[model][position].evaluation.macro_f1) > metrics.rounded_key(candidates[model][best].evaluation.macro_f1)
                best = position
        selected[model] = best
        chosen = chosen.append(candidates[model][best])
    chosen = chosen.append(candidates[3][0])

Run validation_run(Input data, int[] predictions)
    truths := [for document := data.training[] then document.label]
    fold_correct := array(5, fill = 0)
    for: position < int(#truths)
        if truths[position] == predictions[position]
            fold_correct[position % 5] += 1
    return Run(predictions, metrics.Evaluation(data.class_count, truths, predictions), fold_correct)

CrossValidation cross_validate(Input data)
    count := int(#data.training)
    int[][][] guesses := array(3, fill = array(#data.settings.alphas, fill = array(nat(count), fill = 0)))
    centroid_guesses := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    Fold[] folds := []
    for: fold < 5
        members := [for position := (0:<count)[] if position % 5 != fold then data.training[position]]
        held := [for position := (0:<count)[] if position % 5 == fold then position]
        training := Training(members, data.settings.include_bigrams, data.class_count, data.settings.minimum, data.settings.features)
        folds = folds.append(Fold(int(#members), int(#held), training.wordset.candidate_count, training.wordset.vocabulary_size()))
        sequences := [for position := held[] then training.encode(data.training[position])]
        for: model < 3
            for: candidate < int(#data.settings.alphas)
                fitted := bayes.train(model_names()[model], training.tallies, data.settings.alphas[candidate])
                for: position < int(#held)
                    guesses[model][candidate][held[position]] = fitted.predict(sequences[position]).label
        for: position < int(#held)
            centroid_guesses[held[position]] = training.centroid.predict(sequences[position]).label
    Run[][] candidates := []
    for: model < 3
        candidates = candidates.append([for predictions := guesses[model][] then validation_run(data, predictions)])
    candidates = candidates.append([validation_run(data, centroid_guesses)])
    return CrossValidation(candidates, folds)

bayes.Prediction majority_vote(int[] labels, int class_count)
    votes := array(nat(class_count), fill = 0)
    for category := labels[]
        votes[category] += 1
    winner := labels[0]
    for category := labels[]
        if votes[category] > votes[winner]
            winner = category
    return bayes.Prediction(winner, real64(votes[winner]) / real64(#labels), [], [], [], 0.0, 0.0, 0)

metrics.Evaluation[] test_evaluations(Input data, Training training)
    sequences := [for position := data.labelled[] then training.encode(data.tests[position])]
    metrics.Evaluation[] results := []
    for: model < 4
        predicted := [for sequence := sequences[] then training.classify(model, sequence).label]
        results = results.append(metrics.Evaluation(data.class_count, data.truths, predicted))
    return results

class Ratio(int numerator, int denominator, int term)

Ratio[] ratio_ranking(Ratio[] entries)
    Ratio[] order := []
    for entry := entries[]
        place := int(#order)
        order = order.append(entry)
        while place > 0
            prior := order[place - 1]
            left := entry.numerator * prior.denominator
            right := prior.numerator * entry.denominator
            if left < right or left == right and entry.term > prior.term
                break
            order[place] = prior
            place -= 1
        order[place] = entry
    return order

class Experiment(Input data, CrossValidation validation, Training final_training)
    Settings settings := data.settings
    names := model_names()
    int[] alphas := [for model := (0:<3)[] then settings.alphas[validation.selected[model]]]
    int[][] test_sequences := [for document := data.tests[] then final_training.encode(document)]
    bayes.Prediction[][] predictions := []
    for: model < 4
        predictions = predictions.append([for sequence := test_sequences[] then final_training.classify(model, sequence)])
    local bayes.Prediction[] voted := []
    for: position < int(#data.tests)
        labels := [for model := (0:<4)[] then predictions[model][position].label]
        voted = voted.append(majority_vote(labels, data.class_count))
    predictions = predictions.append(voted)
    bool[][] correct := [for model := (0:<5)[] then [for position := data.labelled[] then predictions[model][position].label == data.tests[position].label]]

    string alpha_text(int model)
        return if model < 3 then hundredths_text(alphas[model]) else "-"

    string[] vocabulary_lines()
        vocab.Vocabulary wordset := final_training.wordset
        lines := ["documents {#data.training} terms {wordset.term_count} candidates {wordset.candidate_count} vocabulary {wordset.vocabulary_size()}"]
        for: position < int(#wordset.ranked)
            vocab.RankedTerm entry := wordset.ranked[position]
            lines = lines.append("{position + 1} {entry.name} {entry.frequency} {metrics.real_text(entry.chi2)} {data.classes[entry.best_class]}")
        return lines

    string[] cv_lines()
        lines := ["model,alpha,correct,accuracy,macro_f1,selected"]
        for: model < 4
            for: position < int(#validation.candidates[model])
                alpha := if model < 3 then hundredths_text(settings.alphas[position]) else "-"
                selected := if model < 3 then position == validation.selected[model] else true
                string[] fields := [names[model], alpha].concat(evaluation_fields(validation.candidates[model][position].evaluation))
                lines = lines.append(fields.append(if selected then "yes" else "no").join(","))
        return lines

    string[] prediction_lines()
        lines := ["id,model,label,score"]
        for: position < int(#data.tests)
            for: model < 5
                result := predictions[model][position]
                lines = lines.append("{data.tests[position].name},{names[model]},{data.classes[result.label]},{metrics.real_text(result.score)}")
        return lines

    string[] curve_lines()
        lines := ["size,vocabulary,model,correct,accuracy,macro_f1"]
        for size := settings.curve[]
            training := Training(data.training[0:<size], settings.include_bigrams, data.class_count, settings.minimum, settings.features, alphas)
            results := test_evaluations(data, training)
            for: model < 4
                string[] fields := ["{size}", "{training.wordset.vocabulary_size()}", names[model]].concat(evaluation_fields(results[model]))
                lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] feature_lines()
        lines := ["terms,features,vocabulary,model,correct,accuracy,macro_f1"]
        for pairs := [false, true][]
            kind := if pairs then "bigrams" else "unigrams"
            for size := settings.sizes[]
                training := Training(data.training, pairs, data.class_count, settings.minimum, size, alphas)
                results := test_evaluations(data, training)
                for: model < 4
                    string[] fields := [kind, "{size}", "{training.wordset.vocabulary_size()}", names[model]].concat(evaluation_fields(results[model]))
                    lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] data_part()
        vocab.Vocabulary wordset := final_training.wordset
        lines := ["documents train {#data.training} test {#data.tests} labelled {#data.labelled} unlabelled {#data.unlabelled} classes {data.class_count}"]
        for: category < data.class_count
            train_count := [for document := data.training[] if document.label == category then 1].sum()
            test_count := [for truth := data.truths[] if truth == category then 1].sum()
            lines = lines.append("class {data.classes[category]} train {train_count} test {test_count}")
        raw := 0
        stopped := 0
        short_words := 0
        kept := 0
        pairs := 0
        distinct<string> unique_terms
        for document := data.training[]
            raw += document.parts.raw_count
            stopped += document.parts.stopword_count
            short_words += document.parts.short_count
            kept += int(#document.parts.words)
            if settings.include_bigrams
                pairs += int(#document.parts.bigrams)
            for term := document.parts.terms(settings.include_bigrams)[]
                .unique_terms.add(term)
        distinct_pairs := [for term := unique_terms.values()[] if lexical.is_bigram(term) then 1].sum()
        lines = lines.concat(["train_tokens raw {raw} stopwords {stopped} short {short_words} unigrams {kept} bigrams {pairs}", "train_terms unigrams {int(unique_terms.size()) - distinct_pairs} bigrams {distinct_pairs} candidates {wordset.candidate_count} vocabulary {wordset.vocabulary_size()}"])
        total := [for document := data.tests[] then int(#document.parts.terms(settings.include_bigrams))].sum()
        encoded := [for sequence := test_sequences[] then int(#sequence)].sum()
        lines = lines.append("test_terms total {total} in_vocabulary {encoded}")
        map<string, int> oov
        for document := data.tests[]
            for word := document.parts.words[]
                if not wordset.index.has(word)
                    count := 0
                    match oov.get(word)
                        int present
                            count = present
                        none
                            count = 0
                    .oov.set(word, count + 1)
        words := oov.keys().sorted()
        int[] counts := []
        for word := words[]
            match oov.get(word)
                int present
                    counts = counts.append(present)
                none
                    counts = counts.append(0)
        order := bayes.score_order([for count := counts[] then real64(count)])
        entries := ["test_oov"]
        for: rank < math.min(settings.top, int(#order))
            position := order[rank]
            entries = entries.append("{words[position]} {counts[position]}")
        return lines.append(entries.join(" "))

    string[] folds_part()
        lines := ["folds 5"]
        for: position < int(#validation.folds)
            item := validation.folds[position]
            lines = lines.append("fold {position + 1} train {item.train_count} validate {item.validate_count} candidates {item.candidates} vocabulary {item.vocabulary_size}")
        return lines

    string[] selection_part()
        lines := ["selection"]
        for: model < 4
            chosen := validation.chosen[model]
            fold_counts := [for count := chosen.fold_correct[] then "{count}"].join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("{names[model]} alpha {alpha_text(model)} correct {metrics.proportion_text(chosen.evaluation.correct, chosen.evaluation.total)} macro_f1 {metrics.real_text(chosen.evaluation.macro_f1)} folds {fold_counts}")
        return lines

    string[] cross_part(int model)
        return ["cross_validation {names[model]} alpha {alpha_text(model)}"].concat(validation.chosen[model].evaluation.lines(data.classes))

    string[] test_part(int model)
        bayes.Prediction[] selected := predictions[model][data.labelled]
        result := metrics.Evaluation(data.class_count, data.truths, [for guess := selected[] then guess.label])
        lines := ["test {names[model]} alpha {alpha_text(model)}", "labelled {#selected} correct {metrics.proportion_text(result.correct, int(#selected))}"]
        if model < 4
            top_two := [for position := (0:<int(#selected))[] if data.truths[position] == selected[position].ranking[0] or data.truths[position] == selected[position].ranking[1] then 1].sum()
            lines = lines.append("top2 {metrics.proportion_text(top_two, int(#selected))}")
        return lines.concat(result.lines(data.classes))

    string[] probability_part(int model)
        limits := [for threshold := settings.thresholds[] then real64(threshold) / 100.0]
        count := int(#data.labelled)
        rows := array(#limits + 1, fill = 0)
        hits := array(#limits + 1, fill = 0)
        real64[] sums := array(#limits + 1, fill = 0.0)
        accepted := array(#limits, fill = 0)
        accepted_hits := array(#limits, fill = 0)
        real64 loss := 0.0
        real64 brier := 0.0
        for: position < count
            index := data.labelled[position]
            prediction := predictions[model][index]
            truth := data.truths[position]
            gap := prediction.scores[truth] - prediction.scores[prediction.label]
            loss += math.log(prediction.normalizer) - gap
            real64[] differences := [for category := (0:<data.class_count)[] then prediction.probabilities[category] - (if category == truth then 1.0 else 0.0)]
            brier += (differences * differences).sum()
            bucket := [for limit := limits[] if prediction.score >= limit then 1].sum()
            rows[bucket] += 1
            sums[bucket] += prediction.score
            if correct[model][position]
                hits[bucket] += 1
            for: threshold < int(#limits)
                if prediction.score >= limits[threshold]
                    accepted[threshold] += 1
                    if correct[model][position]
                        accepted_hits[threshold] += 1
        lines := ["probability {names[model]} alpha {alpha_text(model)}", "log_loss {metrics.real_text(loss / real64(count))} brier {metrics.real_text(brier / real64(count))}"]
        bounds := [0]
        bounds = bounds.concat(settings.thresholds)
        for: bucket < int(#bounds)
            text := "bin {hundredths_text(bounds[bucket])} rows {rows[bucket]}"
            if rows[bucket] > 0
                text += " correct {metrics.proportion_text(hits[bucket], rows[bucket])} mean {metrics.real_text(sums[bucket] / real64(rows[bucket]))}"
            lines = lines.append(text)
        for: threshold < int(#limits)
            precise := if accepted[threshold] > 0 then metrics.proportion_text(accepted_hits[threshold], accepted[threshold]) else "-"
            lines = lines.append("threshold {hundredths_text(settings.thresholds[threshold])} covered {metrics.proportion_text(accepted[threshold], count)} correct {precise}")
        return lines

    string[] lengths_part()
        rows := array(#settings.lengths + 1, fill = 0)
        int[][] hits := array(5, fill = array(#settings.lengths + 1, fill = 0))
        for: position < int(#data.labelled)
            index := data.labelled[position]
            bucket := bucket_number(int(#test_sequences[index]), settings.lengths)
            rows[bucket] += 1
            for: model < 5
                if correct[model][position]
                    hits[model][bucket] += 1
        lines := ["lengths"]
        bounds := [0]
        bounds = bounds.concat(settings.lengths)
        for: bucket < int(#bounds)
            parts := ["length {bounds[bucket]} rows {rows[bucket]}"]
            if rows[bucket] > 0
                for: model < 5
                    parts = parts.append("{names[model]} {metrics.proportion_text(hits[model][bucket], rows[bucket])}")
            lines = lines.append(parts.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] comparison_part()
        lines := ["comparison"]
        for pair := model_pairs()[]
            first := pair[0]
            second := pair[1]
            agree := [for position := (0:<int(#data.tests))[] if predictions[first][position].label == predictions[second][position].label then 1].sum()
            b := [for position := (0:<int(#data.labelled))[] if correct[first][position] and not correct[second][position] then 1].sum()
            c := [for position := (0:<int(#data.labelled))[] if correct[second][position] and not correct[first][position] then 1].sum()
            difference := math.max(0, math.abs(b - c) - 1)
            statistic := if b + c > 0 then metrics.fraction_text(difference * difference, b + c) else metrics.fraction_text(0, 1)
            lines = lines.append("{names[first]} {names[second]} agree {metrics.proportion_text(agree, int(#data.tests))} b {b} c {c} statistic {statistic}")
        errors := array(5, fill = 0)
        for: position < int(#data.labelled)
            wrong := [for model := (0:<4)[] if not correct[model][position] then 1].sum()
            errors[wrong] += 1
        totals := [for wrong := (0:<5)[] then "{wrong} {errors[wrong]}"]
        return lines.append("errors " + totals.join(" "))

    string[] bootstrap_part()
        state := settings.seed
        count := int(#data.labelled)
        int[][] totals := array(5, fill = array(nat(settings.resamples), fill = 0))
        for: repetition < settings.resamples
            int[] chosen := []
            for: draw < count
                state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
                chosen = chosen.append(state % count)
            for: model < 5
                totals[model][repetition] = [for position := chosen[] if correct[model][position] then 1].sum()
        tail := settings.resamples / 40
        lines := ["bootstrap resamples {settings.resamples} seed {settings.seed}"]
        for: model < 5
            ordered := totals[model].sorted()
            average := real64(ordered.sum()) / real64(settings.resamples * count)
            lines = lines.append("{names[model]} mean {metrics.real_text(average)} low {metrics.proportion_text(ordered[tail], count)} high {metrics.proportion_text(ordered[int(#ordered) - 1 - tail], count)}")
        for pair := model_pairs()[]
            first := pair[0]
            second := pair[1]
            wins := [for position := (0:<settings.resamples)[] if totals[first][position] > totals[second][position] then 1].sum()
            ties := [for position := (0:<settings.resamples)[] if totals[first][position] == totals[second][position] then 1].sum()
            losses := settings.resamples - wins - ties
            lines = lines.append("pair {names[first]} {names[second]} wins {wins} ties {ties} losses {losses}")
        return lines

    string[] hard_part()
        int[] hard := []
        counts := array(nat(data.class_count), fill = 0)
        for: position < int(#data.training)
            all_wrong := true
            for: model < 4
                if validation.chosen[model].predictions[position] == data.training[position].label
                    all_wrong = false
            if all_wrong
                hard = hard.append(position)
                counts[data.training[position].label] += 1
        lines := ["hard_documents {#hard} {class_counts_text(data.classes, counts)}"]
        for: rank < math.min(settings.top, int(#hard))
            position := hard[rank]
            labels := [for model := (0:<4)[] then data.classes[validation.chosen[model].predictions[position]]]
            lines = lines.append("{data.training[position].name} true {data.classes[data.training[position].label]} predicted " + labels.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] uncertain_part()
        int[] order := []
        for: position < int(#data.tests)
            place := int(#order)
            order = order.append(position)
            while place > 0 and metrics.rounded_key(predictions[0][position].margin) < metrics.rounded_key(predictions[0][order[place - 1]].margin)
                order[place] = order[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            order[place] = position
        shown := math.min(settings.top, int(#order))
        lines := ["uncertain multinomial {shown}"]
        for: rank < shown
            position := order[rank]
            document := data.tests[position]
            guess := predictions[0][position]
            truth := if document.label < 0 then "?" else data.classes[document.label]
            lines = lines.append("{document.name} predicted {data.classes[guess.label]} runner_up {data.classes[guess.runner_up]} margin {metrics.real_text(guess.margin)} posterior {metrics.real_text(guess.score)} true {truth}")
        return lines

    string[] evidence_lines(int[] sequence, int predicted, int truth)
        int[][] occurrences := final_training.tallies.occurrences
        weights := final_training.fitted[0].weights
        entries := [for term := vocab.first_occurrences(sequence)[] then Ratio(100 * occurrences[predicted][term] + alphas[0], 100 * occurrences[truth][term] + alphas[0], term)]
        order := ratio_ranking(entries)
        string[] lines := []
        for: rank < math.min(3, int(#order))
            term := order[rank].term
            count := [for value := sequence[] if value == term then 1].sum()
            evidence := weights[predicted][term] - weights[truth][term]
            lines = lines.append("  {final_training.wordset.terms[term]} count {count} evidence {metrics.real_text(evidence)}")
        return lines

    string[] misclassified_part()
        wrong := [for position := data.labelled[] if predictions[0][position].label != data.tests[position].label then position]
        lines := ["misclassified multinomial {#wrong}"]
        for position := wrong[]
            document := data.tests[position]
            guess := predictions[0][position]
            lines = lines.append("{document.name} true {data.classes[document.label]} predicted {data.classes[guess.label]} posterior {metrics.real_text(guess.score)}")
            lines = lines.concat(evidence_lines(test_sequences[position], guess.label, document.label))
        return lines

    bayes.Model maximization(bayes.Prediction[] posteriors, int[][] sequences)
        bayes.Counts tallies := final_training.tallies
        real64[][] occurrences := [for row := tallies.occurrences[] then [for count := row[] then real64(count)]]
        documents := [for count := tallies.documents[] then real64(count)]
        weight := real64(settings.weight) / 100.0
        for: position < int(#sequences)
            sequence := sequences[position]
            first := vocab.first_occurrences(sequence)
            frequencies := array(nat(final_training.wordset.vocabulary_size()), fill = 0)
            for term := sequence[]
                frequencies[term] += 1
            for: category < data.class_count
                share := weight * posteriors[position].probabilities[category]
                documents[category] += share
                for term := first[]
                    occurrences[category][term] += share * real64(frequencies[term])
        int size := final_training.wordset.vocabulary_size()
        real64[][] weights := []
        for row := occurrences[]
            total := row.sum()
            weights = weights.append([for count := row[] then bayes.smoothed_real_log(count, total, alphas[0], size)])
        scale := real64(#data.training) + real64(settings.weight * int(#data.unlabelled)) / 100.0
        real64[] priors := [for count := documents[] then math.log(count / scale)]
        return bayes.Model("multinomial", priors, array(nat(data.class_count), fill = 0.0), weights)

    string[] semi_supervised_part()
        sequences := [for document := data.unlabelled[] then final_training.encode(document)]
        fitted := final_training.fitted[0]
        int[] previous := []
        lines := ["semi_supervised multinomial alpha {alpha_text(0)} weight {hundredths_text(settings.weight)} unlabelled {#data.unlabelled}"]
        for: iteration <= settings.iterations
            posteriors := [for sequence := sequences[] then fitted.predict(sequence)]
            assignments := [for guess := posteriors[] then guess.label]
            labels := [for position := data.labelled[] then fitted.predict(test_sequences[position]).label]
            result := metrics.Evaluation(data.class_count, data.truths, labels)
            changed := "-"
            if iteration > 0
                count := [for position := (0:<int(#assignments))[] if previous[position] != assignments[position] then 1].sum()
                changed = "{count}"
            assigned := array(nat(data.class_count), fill = 0)
            for category := assignments[]
                assigned[category] += 1
            lines = lines.append("iteration {iteration} correct {metrics.proportion_text(result.correct, result.total)} macro_f1 {metrics.real_text(result.macro_f1)} changed {changed} assigned {class_counts_text(data.classes, assigned)}")
            if iteration < settings.iterations
                fitted = maximization(posteriors, sequences)
            previous = assignments
        return lines

    string[] metrics_lines()
        string[][] parts := [data_part(), folds_part(), selection_part()]
        for: model < 4
            parts = parts.append(cross_part(model))
        for: model < 5
            parts = parts.append(test_part(model))
        for: model < 3
            parts = parts.append(probability_part(model))
        parts = parts.concat([lengths_part(), comparison_part(), bootstrap_part(), hard_part(), uncertain_part(), misclassified_part(), semi_supervised_part()])
        return join_blocks(parts)

    string[][] characteristic_parts(int model)
        bayes.Counts tallies := final_training.tallies
        int size := final_training.wordset.vocabulary_size()
        alpha := alphas[model]
        table := if model == 0 then tallies.occurrences else tallies.containing
        int[] totals := if model == 0 then tallies.totals else tallies.documents
        overall := if model == 0 then tallies.total else tallies.document_total
        outcomes := if model == 0 then size else 2
        term_totals := [for term := (0:<size)[] then [for row := table[] then row[term]].sum()]
        string[][] parts := [["model {names[model]} alpha {alpha_text(model)} vocabulary {size} top {settings.top}"]]
        for: category < data.class_count
            total := totals[category]
            other := overall - total
            lines := ["class {data.classes[category]} total {total} other {other}"]
            entries := [for term := (0:<size)[] then Ratio(100 * table[category][term] + alpha, 100 * (term_totals[term] - table[category][term]) + alpha, term)]
            order := ratio_ranking(entries)
            for: rank < math.min(settings.top, size)
                term := order[rank].term
                count := table[category][term]
                other_count := term_totals[term] - count
                odds := bayes.smoothed_integer_log(count, total, alpha, outcomes) - bayes.smoothed_integer_log(other_count, other, alpha, outcomes)
                lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} {final_training.wordset.terms[term]} {count} {other_count} {metrics.real_text(odds)}")
            parts = parts.append(lines)
        return parts

    string[] top_feature_lines()
        return join_blocks(characteristic_parts(0).concat(characteristic_parts(1)))

void run_experiment()
    data := read_input()
    validation := cross_validate(data)
    alphas := [for model := (0:<3)[] then data.settings.alphas[validation.selected[model]]]
    final_training := Training(data.training, data.settings.include_bigrams, data.class_count, data.settings.minimum, data.settings.features, alphas)
    experiment := Experiment(data, validation, final_training)
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_output("vocabulary.txt", experiment.vocabulary_lines())
    write_output("cv_results.csv", experiment.cv_lines())
    write_output("predictions.csv", experiment.prediction_lines())
    write_output("learning_curve.csv", experiment.curve_lines())
    write_output("feature_study.csv", experiment.feature_lines())
    write_output("metrics.txt", experiment.metrics_lines())
    write_output("top_features.txt", experiment.top_feature_lines())

if main
    run_experiment()

import math
import vocab = "./vocabulary.qui"

real64 smoothed_integer_log(int observed, int mass, int alpha, int outcomes)
    numerator := 100 * observed + alpha
    denominator := 100 * mass + alpha * outcomes
    return math.log(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator))

real64 smoothed_real_log(real64 observed, real64 mass, int alpha, int outcomes)
    return math.log((100.0 * observed + real64(alpha)) / (100.0 * mass + real64(alpha * outcomes)))

class Counts(local int[][] encoded, local int[] labels, int classes, int term_count)
    document_total := int(#encoded)
    documents := array(nat(classes), fill = 0)
    int[][] occurrences := array(nat(classes), fill = array(nat(term_count), fill = 0))
    int[][] containing := array(nat(classes), fill = array(nat(term_count), fill = 0))
    for: document < int(#encoded)
        category := labels[document]
        documents[category] += 1
        for term := encoded[document][]
            occurrences[category][term] += 1
        for term := vocab.first_occurrences(encoded[document])[]
            containing[category][term] += 1
    int[] totals := [for row := occurrences[] then row.sum()]
    int total := totals.sum()
    int[] term_totals := [for term := (0:<term_count)[] then [for row := occurrences[] then row[term]].sum()]

    real64[] log_priors()
        return [for count := documents[] then math.log(real64(count) / real64(document_total))]

int[] score_order(real64[] values)
    int[] order := []
    for: category < int(#values)
        place := int(#order)
        order = order.append(category)
        while place > 0 and values[category] > values[order[place - 1]]
            order[place] = order[place - 1]
            place -= 1
        order[place] = category
    return order

class Prediction(int label, real64 score, int[] ranking, real64[] scores, real64[] probabilities, real64 normalizer, real64 margin, int runner_up)

Prediction posterior(real64[] values)
    order := score_order(values)
    best := order[0]
    real64[] exponentials := [for value := values[] then math.exp(value - values[best])]
    total := exponentials.sum()
    probabilities := exponentials / total
    return Prediction(best, probabilities[best], order, values, probabilities, total, values[best] - values[order[1]], order[1])

class Model(string kind, real64[] priors, real64[] base, real64[][] weights)
    real64[] class_scores(int[] sequence)
        selected := if kind == "bernoulli" then vocab.first_occurrences(sequence) else sequence
        real64[] result := []
        for: category < int(#weights)
            accumulated := base[category]
            for term := selected[]
                accumulated += weights[category][term]
            result = result.append(accumulated + priors[category])
        return result

    Prediction predict(int[] sequence)
        return posterior(class_scores(sequence))

Model train(string variant, Counts counts, int alpha)
    real64[] base := array(nat(counts.classes), fill = 0.0)
    real64[][] weights := array(nat(counts.classes), fill = array(nat(counts.term_count), fill = 0.0))
    for: category < counts.classes
        for: term < counts.term_count
            if variant == "multinomial"
                weights[category][term] = smoothed_integer_log(counts.occurrences[category][term], counts.totals[category], alpha, counts.term_count)
            elif variant == "bernoulli"
                present := smoothed_integer_log(counts.containing[category][term], counts.documents[category], alpha, 2)
                absent := smoothed_integer_log(counts.documents[category] - counts.containing[category][term], counts.documents[category], alpha, 2)
                base[category] += absent
                weights[category][term] = present - absent
            else
                weights[category][term] = -smoothed_integer_log(counts.term_totals[term] - counts.occurrences[category][term], counts.total - counts.totals[category], alpha, counts.term_count)
    return Model(variant, counts.log_priors(), base, weights)

import math
import bayes = "./naive_bayes.qui"

real64 vector_length(real64[] values)
    return math.sqrt((values * values).sum())

class Centroids(local int[][] encoded, local int[] labels, local int classes, local int[] frequencies)
    real64[] idf := [for frequency := frequencies[] then math.log(real64(#encoded) / real64(frequency))]
    real64[][] centers := array(nat(classes), fill = array(#frequencies, fill = 0.0))
    real64[] lengths := []
    local documents := array(nat(classes), fill = 0)
    for: document < int(#encoded)
        category := labels[document]
        documents[category] += 1
        counts := array(#frequencies, fill = 0)
        for term := encoded[document][]
            counts[term] += 1
        values := [for count := counts[] then real64(count)] * idf
        magnitude := vector_length(values)
        if magnitude > 0.0
            centers[category] = centers[category] + values / magnitude
    for: category < classes
        centers[category] = centers[category] / real64(documents[category])
        lengths = lengths.append(vector_length(centers[category]))

    real64[] vector(int[] sequence)
        counts := array(#idf, fill = 0)
        for term := sequence[]
            counts[term] += 1
        return [for count := counts[] then real64(count)] * idf

    bayes.Prediction predict(int[] sequence)
        real64[] values := vector(sequence)
        magnitude := vector_length(values)
        real64[] similarities := []
        for: category < int(#centers)
            real64 similarity := 0.0
            if magnitude > 0.0 and lengths[category] > 0.0
                similarity = (values * centers[category]).sum() / (magnitude * lengths[category])
            similarities = similarities.append(similarity)
        order := bayes.score_order(similarities)
        return bayes.Prediction(order[0], similarities[order[0]], order, similarities, [], 0.0, 0.0, order[1])

string lowercase_symbol(string symbol)
    upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    match upper.find(symbol)
        nat found
            return lower[found]
        none
            return symbol

bool is_bigram(string term)
    return term.contains("_")

class Tokens(local string article, local distinct<string> stops)
    raw_count := 0
    stopword_count := 0
    short_count := 0
    string[] words := []
    string[] bigrams := []
    string[] combined := []
    local string[] extracted := []
    local current := ""
    for: position < int(#article)
        symbol := lowercase_symbol(article[position])
        if "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(symbol)
            current += symbol
        elif current != ""
            extracted = extracted.append(current)
            current = ""
    if current != ""
        extracted = extracted.append(current)
    raw_count = int(#extracted)
    for word := extracted[]
        if stops.has(word)
            stopword_count += 1
        elif #word == 1
            short_count += 1
        else
            words = words.append(word)
    for: position < int(#words) - 1
        bigrams = bigrams.append(words[position] + "_" + words[position + 1])
    combined = words.concat(bigrams)

    string[] terms(bool include_bigrams)
        return if include_bigrams then combined else words

int[] first_occurrences(int[] sequence)
    distinct<int> seen
    int[] result := []
    for term := sequence[]
        if not seen.has(term)
            .seen.add(term)
            result = result.append(term)
    return result

int[] document_counts(map<string, int[]> table, string key, int width)
    match table.get(key)
        int[] present
            return present
        none
            return array(nat(width), fill = 0)

real64 chi_square(int present, int frequency, int class_size, int total)
    other_present := frequency - present
    absent := class_size - present
    other_absent := total - class_size - other_present
    difference := present * other_absent - other_present * absent
    numerator := total * difference * difference
    denominator := frequency * (total - frequency) * class_size * (total - class_size)
    return if denominator == 0 then 0.0 else real64(numerator) / real64(denominator)

class RankedTerm(string name, int frequency, real64 chi2, int best_class)

class Vocabulary(local string[][] texts, local int[] labels, local int categories, local int minimum, local int limit)
    term_count := 0
    candidate_count := 0
    RankedTerm[] ranked := []
    string[] terms := []
    index := map<string, int>()
    int[] frequencies := []
    local map<string, int[]> counts
    local class_sizes := array(nat(categories), fill = 0)
    for: document < int(#texts)
        category := labels[document]
        class_sizes[category] += 1
        distinct<string> seen
        for term := texts[document][]
            if not seen.has(term)
                .seen.add(term)
                row := document_counts(counts, term, categories)
                row[category] += 1
                .counts.set(term, row)
    local all_terms := counts.keys().sorted()
    term_count = int(#all_terms)
    for term := all_terms[]
        row := document_counts(counts, term, categories)
        frequency := row.sum()
        if frequency < minimum
            continue
        best := 0
        largest := chi_square(row[0], frequency, class_sizes[0], int(#texts))
        for: 1 <= category < categories
            score := chi_square(row[category], frequency, class_sizes[category], int(#texts))
            if score > largest
                best = category
                largest = score
        entry := RankedTerm(term, frequency, largest, best)
        place := int(#ranked)
        ranked = ranked.append(entry)
        while place > 0 and entry.chi2 > ranked[place - 1].chi2
            ranked[place] = ranked[place - 1]
            place -= 1
        ranked[place] = entry
    candidate_count = int(#ranked)
    if limit > 0 and int(#ranked) > limit
        ranked = ranked[0:<limit]
    terms = ([for entry := ranked[] then entry.name]).sorted()
    for: term_position < int(#terms)
        .index.set(terms[term_position], term_position)
        frequencies = frequencies.append(document_counts(counts, terms[term_position], categories).sum())

    int vocabulary_size()
        return int(#terms)

    int[] encode(string[] sequence)
        int[] result := []
        for term := sequence[]
            match index.get(term)
                int found
                    result = result.append(found)
                none
                    continue
        return result
